verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is a first-class, tightly integrated product ('Automate sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance on all your transactions') that works alongside Billing/Invoicing, but the evidence pack is only vendor docs with no independent/hands-on corroboration of registration management, rate accuracy, or invoice-level tax application in practice. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of tax calculation accuracy on invoices, detail on registration management across jurisdictions, and confirmation this is native rather than a separate paid add-on product.
